title: Voidcantation
description: This mod  is made using fabric api and tested for minecraft version 1.21. It adds three unique items to the game, the void pocket, the phase dagger and the architects compass that adds some unique elements to the game.
body:
This mod made using fabric api and tested in minecraft 1.21 adds three unique items to the game - The Phase Dagger, The Void Pocket and The Architect's Compass.

**1. Phase Dagger - Turn the tide of combat by instantly manipulating physical reality and positioning.**

- The phase dagger allows the player to tap into a stance using right click and the player can use right click to select a maximum number of four mobs.
  
- When the mobs are selected, the mobs will perish before the player even gets the time to react what happened as the mobs firstly get bombarded with slashes accompanied by explosions. The weapon will have a 15 second cooldown before it's ability can be used again.

**2. Void Pocket - A pocket-dimension storage unit designed to hold and compress near-infinite quantities of a single block or item type. The void pocket can also be sacrificed in he void to get a potion of void that gives the son of void effect which lets the player be completely untouched by void and he will teleport to the overworld after jumping into void. Player also gets void aura protecting him as long he has the son of void effect when he attacks mobs.**
- Massive Singular Deep Storage: Shift + Right-Click an item to safely compress and suck it into the pocket dimension.
- Classic Bundle Release: Emptying the pocket is simple—just Right-Click the item to release the stored contents cleanly back into your inventory, matching native vanilla bundle behavior.
- Dynamic Texture States: Features reactive visual rendering that switches between empty (void_pocket_empty.png) and active (void_pocket_full.png) item textures based on real-time data contents.
- Ultra-Flat 2D Hand Models: Custom-scaled on the Z-axis to stay perfectly flat. This completely removes the blocky, thick 3D voxel extrusion rendering glitch commonly seen when custom item sprites are held in first-person or third-person views.

**3. Architect's Compass - Never lose track of your builds, structures, or dimensions again.**

- Coordinate Bookmarking: Simply Shift + Right-Click any block while holding the compass to lock its exact coordinates into the item stack's memory.
- Distance Tracking: The compass dynamically tracks and displays your exact blocks-away distance from your saved bookmark directly on your HUD.
- Visual Overlays: Renders a striking, End Portal-style particle line stretching out into the sky, pointing you directly toward your bookmarked structure.
